items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: But I believe, I don't know what his first name was, Lewis, but I know everybody called him Bobo.

ctx.x: Well, he saw Lewis and David Lewis, them his two sons too. But he had an older son come here, played bass trombone. They said he's the talk of New Orleans. He used to play with this buddy of old. His name was Bobo, Bobo. Called him Bobo. But I believe, I don't know what his first name was, Lewis, but I know everybody called him Bobo. And they said he was a tuba playing man out of the world. But I never heard no talk of him here in New Orleans.
